story.title: I want a drum
paragraphs_en: Kunju asked his mother to get him a drum. His mother went to the store, but there were none there. Instead, she gave him a piece of wood. Hitting the wooden log Kunju sang.....
"Asked for a drum, got a piece of wood, DUM DUM DUM"
"Exchanged the wood for a dosa, DUM DUM DUM"
"Exchanged the dosa for a clay pot, DUM DUM DUM"
"Exchanged the pot for a shirt, DUM DUM DUM"
"Exchanged the shirt for a horse, DUM DUM DUM"
"Exchanged the horse for a ... Drum, DUM DUM DUM"

sentences.text_en: Kunju asked his mother to get him a drum.
sentences.text_vi: Kunju xin mẹ mua cho một cái trống.

sentences.text_en: His mother went to the store, but there were none there.
sentences.text_vi: Mẹ cậu đi ra cửa hàng, nhưng không có cái trống nào cả.

sentences.text_en: Instead, she gave him a piece of wood.
sentences.text_vi: Thay vào đó, mẹ đưa cho cậu một khúc gỗ.

sentences.text_en: Hitting the wooden log Kunju sang.....
sentences.text_vi: Vừa gõ khúc gỗ, Kunju vừa hát.....

sentences.text_en: "Asked for a drum, got a piece of wood, DUM DUM DUM"
sentences.text_vi: "Xin cái trống, được khúc gỗ, DÙM DÙM DÙM"

sentences.text_en: "Exchanged the wood for a dosa, DUM DUM DUM"
sentences.text_vi: "Đổi khúc gỗ lấy bánh dosa, DÙM DÙM DÙM"

sentences.text_en: "Exchanged the dosa for a clay pot, DUM DUM DUM"
sentences.text_vi: "Đổi bánh dosa lấy cái nồi đất, DÙM DÙM DÙM"

sentences.text_en: "Exchanged the pot for a shirt, DUM DUM DUM"
sentences.text_vi: "Đổi cái nồi lấy cái áo, DÙM DÙM DÙM"

sentences.text_en: "Exchanged the shirt for a horse, DUM DUM DUM"
sentences.text_vi: "Đổi cái áo lấy con ngựa, DÙM DÙM DÙM"

activities.identity_vi: Con đọc từng câu cho Minny nghe nhé!
activities.instructions_vi: Nghe lại câu mẫu rồi đọc to và rõ.
